name: Pagination
summary: Page controls for a long list or table: first, previous, page numbers with ellipses, next and last, with an optional item summary such as 21 to 40 of 312.
useWhen: A list or table split into pages of a fixed size, where readers need to know where they are and jump to a page
Search results or an archive where a page number can be shared in a URL, with getHref
A data table footer that shows which rows are on screen, with itemCount and pageSize
avoidWhen: A feed read from top to bottom, where loading more on scroll or a Load more button fits better
Steps of a task done in order
Fewer items than one page holds, unless the summary is still useful
Moving between slides of a carousel

insteadUse.A feed that grows as the reader scrolls: Button with Load more items, or infinite loading

page.description: The current page, from 1. Controlled, with onPageChange. Clamped into 1 to the page count.

defaultPage.description: The first page shown when uncontrolled.

onPageChange.description: Called with the new page when a control is pressed. Not called for the current page.

pageCount.description: The number of pages. Default: worked out from itemCount and pageSize, else 1. A count under 1 or NaN reads as 1.

itemCount.description: The number of items in the list. Turns on the summary part. A count that is not a finite number (NaN, Infinity) shows no summary and counts as one page.

pageSize.description: Items per page, for the summary and the page count. A size under 1 or not a finite number reads as 20.

siblings.description: Pages shown on each side of the current page (pageRange in @the-system/shared).

boundaries.description: Pages always shown at each end.

showEnds.description: Shows the first and last page buttons.

getHref.description: Turns every control into a link (Button asChild with an a). Default none: buttons. A click with a modifier key or a middle click is left to the browser and does not change the page.

size.description: Control height, as Button: sm 28, md 32, lg 44 at default density.

shape.description: Corner shape of every control, as Button.

disabled.description: Every control is inert (aria-disabled, still focusable), for example while the list loads.

label.description: The accessible name of the nav landmark, not visible text. Under an Arabic Theme the default is التنقل بين الصفحات.

formatSummary.description: Replaces the summary text. Default 21 to 40 of 312, in Arabic 21 إلى 40 من 312. An empty list says No items, in Arabic ما فيه عناصر.

a11y.role: navigation landmark (nav with aria-label) of buttons, or links with getHref
a11y.focus: Every control is a tab stop in reading order. An end with nowhere to go stays focusable with aria-disabled, so focus is not lost on the first or last page; in link mode, where Button drops the href of an inert link, Pagination gives it tabIndex 0. Each page control is keyed by its number at one level of the list, so focus stays on the pressed page when the window of pages shifts (4 to 5, 250 to 251). A 2px ring from the Button focus tokens.
a11y.announce: Each page reads as Page 5, the current one as Page 5, current page. The ends read First page, Previous page, Next page, Last page. Ellipses are aria-hidden. The summary is plain text before the controls.
notes: The current page has a border in color.text.muted (5.76:1 to 8.58:1 against the page across Studio, Desk and Neutral, dark and light; WCAG 1.4.11), a weight step from font.weight.regular to font.weight.bold (400 to 700, 400 to 600 in Neutral), a soft fill and aria-current page, never color alone (WCAG 1.4.1).
The ends use chevrons-back, chevron-back, chevron-forward and chevrons-forward, mirrored in RTL.
Numbers use Western digits in both languages, grouped with a comma (12,480).

Under breakpoint.phone (30rem) the compact form keeps the ends, the current page and the last page, with a compact-only ellipsis (data-compact) between them when pages are hidden; the summary takes its own line and wraps. No sideways scroll at 320px (WCAG 1.4.10).
The page row keeps the same length as the current page moves (pageRange), so controls do not jump under the pointer.
A page label Page 5 contains the visible number, so voice control by the number works (WCAG 2.5.3).
data-active and data-disabled sit on the child controls (page, and first, previous, next, last), not on the root. disabled makes every control aria-disabled.

en.summary: First to last item of the total: 21 to 40 of 312. Name the items in formatSummary when the page does not: 21 to 40 of 312 boards.
en.labels: Page 5, First page, Previous page, Next page, Last page. These are not a verb plus a noun: they are the standard names of pagination controls, an accepted exception to the button rule.

ar.summary: 21 إلى 40 من 312, Western digits. Empty list: ما فيه عناصر.
ar.labels: صفحة 5، الصفحة الأولى، الصفحة السابقة، الصفحة التالية، الصفحة الأخيرة. Noun form, no diacritics.

react.behavior: nav of system Button and IconButton (asChild links with getHref); pageRange and itemRange from @the-system/shared
react.note: The only motion is the Button press, reduced to none under reduced motion. Round 2 (order 1.22, proposed), interaction pagination-roll: the current page holds an empty aria-hidden span (inside the page part) that draws its fill so the shared pill can slide it; page numbers sit in an aria-hidden span in the label (the page keeps its aria-label) and roll digit by digit with rollDigits when the window shifts; a pressed arrow winds up (back by distance.nudge, forward by distance.shift).

angular.behavior: nav[dsPagination] with button[dsButton] or a[dsButton] controls and the shared pageRange

native.note: A row of Pressables with accessibilityState selected on the current page; the compact form on phones.

styles.studio: Ghost page buttons at regular weight, the current page bold with a soft fill and a muted text color border, pixel chevrons on the ends.
styles.desk: The same from the Desk tokens: pill controls, the current page bordered.
styles.neutral: Takes the tokens of the Neutral style, no recipe.

mistakes.wrong: The current page told apart by color only
mistakes.right: Pagination, which adds a 3:1 border, a weight step and aria-current page

mistakes.wrong: Previous and next removed on the first and last page, so focus is lost
mistakes.right: Pagination, which keeps them focusable with aria-disabled

mistakes.wrong: A row of every page number for 500 pages
mistakes.right: Pagination, which shows boundaries, siblings and ellipses

mistakes.wrong: Arrow characters typed as previous and next labels
mistakes.right: The mirrored chevron icons with spoken labels

mistakes.wrong: Eastern Arabic digits in the page numbers
mistakes.right: Western digits, the default in both languages
